mike: Quick thread: I want a tiny, consistent surface for client apps across routing/quotas/rollouts. Call it a "status envelope".
tara: What fields?
mike: Minimal: envelope_code (ok|soft_degrade|quota_limit|hard_fail), http_status, hint_key, ui_message_key. Keep internal_ids out.
ben: Add subcode for retry semantics: transient_vs_terminal. SDKs map that to retry policy.
tara: Console mapping: envelope_code -> badge color + collapse window of 60s to avoid spam.
mike: Headers: X-Status-Envelope: true and optional X-Quota-Remaining if tenant allows. Also X-Envelope-Reason for telemetry.
ben: For streaming/gRPC send an initial envelope frame then tokens; if hard_fail, close stream cleanly with final envelope.
ops-bot: deploy queued: feature/status-envelope canary 5% at 2024-09-01T02:00Z
tara: Tests: simulate quota flaps and assert no more than 3 envelope changes per minute for same route.
mike: I'll draft RFC with schema + SDK mapping. Closing, will link RFC here.
